question: What rare matter has the goddess asked Bhairava to explain?
premises: Bhairava expresses strong approval to the great goddess.
He states that he has been asked.
The subject asked about is hard for the gods to obtain.
inference: The goddess has asked about a matter that is difficult even for the gods to obtain.
plain_english: Well said, well said, O great goddess. I have been asked about something hard for even the gods to obtain.
